method: Agent visual source adjudication; answers frozen before first predictions. Not independent human signoff, not population accuracy. Synthetic unit tests are excluded.
precision_definition: Correct, interpretable product parameters / ALL automatically verified fact groups. Wrong product, material truncation, quantity-changing unit case, and non-parameter noise fail. Cosmetic label contamination is accepted when the correct parameter remains explicit, and recorded. Source-local family ownership is accepted when no false explicit SKU is asserted. No credit merely because raw evidence contains the answer.
coverage_definition: Unique fully correct adopted checkpoints / 116 predeclared checkpoints. This is not exhaustive document recall. A duplicate never adds coverage; partial compound facts credit only a complete explicitly linked checkpoint. No majority vote or fabricated ground truth.
unit_adjudication: Upper/lower case allowed for ordinary words, not byte/bit or mega/milli prefixes. Original proof is retained locally. Timepulse MHz lowercasing is also a prefix defect; see adjudications if affected.
limitations: 5 official PDFs, 5 domains, 17 pages; selected source checkpoints are not an exhaustive census.
Agent-created gold and agent post-run semantic audit; a second independent annotator has not checked these judgments.
Single execution per route at each measured stage; timings are observed samples, not benchmark percentiles.
Source family defaults are accepted within each isolated case, not proof of multi-product identity correctness.
Intermediate repaired-native and repaired-final runs are diagnostic, not independent tests or final scores.
Full PDFs and complete raw outputs stay in ignored local runtime storage; IDs and hashes identify this execution, not portable group IDs across directories.
